experiments.name: Indian GST invoice extraction — primary benchmark
experiments.scope: All 197 official test invoices from Divya52/indian-gst-invoices. PP-OCRv5 English mobile on CPU (about 3.1M stored model values), GST-aware parser, original publisher labels, no fine-tuning. Five core header fields; numbers below use raw found readings.
experiments.limitation: Synthetic Indian invoices; publisher labels are not independently human audited. Core values are not every GST field. Missing readings and processing failures count against recall. This test was already inspected in the older baseline; the new pipeline was developed on training/validation data. No verified purchase-order history or catalog-match labels: these are extraction scores, not invoice approval accuracy or automation.

experiments.name: Indian GST source-verification gate
experiments.scope: Same 197 test invoices after withholding readings flagged by the application for source verification. No human corrections are applied. Denominators include all labelled core values.
experiments.limitation: The gate is an OCR-quality heuristic, not a calibrated correctness probability. Withholding reduces coverage and does not prove that retained readings are safe to approve.

experiments.name: Indian GST separate robustness suites
experiments.scope: 24 source adversarial invoices and 40 Hindi/Kannada invoices, reported separately from the main English test. Raw five-header recall includes missing values and technical failures.
experiments.limitation: Regional scripts exceed the current automatic application scope. These scores are not averaged into the primary result and do not establish resistance to every document attack.

experiments.name: OCR validation comparison
experiments.scope: Same 60 validation images with the GST parser. Model selection evidence; separate from the official test. Both readers run without invoice-answer access.
experiments.limitation: Validation is used for selection, not independent confirmation. Separate 130-image calibration retains some high-confidence errors; OCR scores are not correctness probabilities.

experiments.name: Local application acceptance
experiments.scope: Actual PDF processing, PostgreSQL, staff review, current-balance approval and the browser UI. Latest full regression run.
experiments.limitation: Functional tests on fictional inputs, not accuracy on representative unseen invoices. Axe scanned the login and mobile workspace; it does not certify every accessibility requirement.

experiments.name: Authored edge-case validation
experiments.scope: 25 author-known synthetic scenarios, four PDF representations each. Separate from application integration tests.
experiments.limitation: Controlled layouts and explicit product codes. The author also wrote the implementation; no independent human label audit or unseen-invoice accuracy guarantee.

experiments.name: MiniLM retrieval diagnostic
experiments.scope: 36 simple descriptions against 80 fictional catalog items. Original experiment used GPU; local application uses the pinned ONNX model on CPU.
experiments.limitation: Previously inspected categories, matchable queries only. These results do not establish calibrated confidence or approval safety.

experiments.name: Harder matching experiment
experiments.scope: 720 fictional product-description pairs. Fine-tuned checkpoint evaluated at a score-ranked 90% pair automation budget.
experiments.limitation: A separate development experiment; that trained cross-encoder is not the live approval policy. Pair coverage is not invoice automation.

primary_invoice_evaluation.headline: External Indian GST baseline; no full invoice approval or retrieval truth
primary_invoice_evaluation.reader: PP-OCRv5 English mobile ONNX CPU + printed GST columns
primary_invoice_evaluation.test_status: Disclosed re-score of previously inspected test; source labels unchanged
